title: Speak Slowly
description: Start by speaking slowly and clearly instead of speaking very fast.
example: I would like to improve my communication skills.
tip: Clear pronunciation is more important than speed.

title: Focus on Word Stress
description: English words often have one stressed syllable. Stress improves natural speaking.
tip: Listen carefully and repeat the stressed part louder.

title: Practice Daily
description: Daily speaking practice improves fluency and confidence naturally.
example: Practice speaking English for at least 10 minutes daily.

title: Use Business Vocabulary
description: Learning professional vocabulary improves workplace communication.
example: We need to schedule a client meeting tomorrow.

title: Listen Before Speaking
description: Carefully listening to pronunciation improves speaking accuracy.
example: Please share the updated sales report.

title: Practice Full Sentences
description: Speaking complete sentences builds natural conversation flow.
example: I am preparing for an important business presentation.

title: Improve Confidence
description: Confidence makes spoken English sound more natural and professional.
example: I can communicate effectively in English.
tip: Do not fear mistakes while speaking.

title: Repeat Difficult Words
description: Repeating difficult vocabulary improves pronunciation memory.

title: Use Natural Pauses
description: Small pauses make your English clearer and easier to understand.
example: Good morning, everyone. Today, I will explain our project progress.
tip: Pause slightly after commas and full stops.

title: Think in English
description: Thinking directly in English improves fluency faster.
example: Instead of translating mentally, respond naturally in English.
tip: Start with small daily thoughts in English.
